items.metric_text: adjusted diluted net earnings per share
items.evidence: Based on current foreign currency exchange rates, we expect adjusted diluted net earnings per share to be in the range of $5.07-$5.12 for the full year.

If foreign currency exchange rates hold near current levels, we expect sales in the full year of 2015 to be negatively impacted by approximately 4.0% and adjusted diluted net earnings per share to be negatively impacted by approximately $0.25 in the full year.
